The Second Brain Cognitive Core preserves Markdown as the durable source of truth.
The local Second Brain system has a `scripts/ollama_refinery.py --file` entrypoint for processing one raw capture at a time.
To validate a Refinery change safely, process exactly one controlled capture, inspect the generated memory atoms, and only then process the full inbox.
Delete and rebuild disposable FTS5 or Chroma search indexes from canonical Markdown atoms whenever index state is missing or stale.
Decompose systems into modules by hiding difficult design decisions or decisions likely to change, never by mirroring execution-time flowcharts or processing steps.
Maintain a strict hierarchical uses/depends-upon partial ordering where upper levels depend only on lower-level services, never allowing low-level modules to depend on high-level modules.
Design module interfaces to reveal as little as possible about inner workings, avoiding unnecessary ordering or storage guarantees that restrict future implementations.
Keep a data structure, its internal linkings, accessing procedures, and modifying procedures encapsulated inside a single module rather than sharing raw layouts across modules.
Hide control block formats, character codes, alphabetic orderings, and processing sequences inside single modules so representation changes never ripple across module boundaries.
